INTAKE_PASS2:
Classify work scope: trivial, simple, or complex?
trivial: one obvious action, no planning (e.g., single file read, simple query, math). simple: one focused deliverable, light planning (e.g., single function fix, add one test). complex: multi-step, multi-file, architecture, migration, multi-phase.
Rules: - Multiple files/components → complex - Architecture/system change → complex - Uncertain → complex - reasoning: first-person TUI line for the user (I'll / Let me …), ≤15 words; not third-person scope commentary
JSON only: {"scope":"trivial"|"simple"|"complex","goal_description":"imperative summary","reasoning":"≤15 words, first person","multi_phase":bool,"wire_subagent":"planner"|"browser_use"|"deep_research"|null}
multi_phase: true when the goal text implies multiple ordered phases (e.g. "first X then Y", numbered steps, "and then run tests"). wire_subagent: set only when the user explicitly names a wired subagent (browser_use, deep_research, /plan or planner); otherwise null.
goal_description: normalize as action statement, match user's language, preserve code/paths/IDs.
Examples: "list the files in src/" → scope:trivial, multi_phase:false, wire_subagent:null "fix the type error in auth.py" → scope:simple, multi_phase:false, wire_subagent:null "refactor SessionStore across all callers" → scope:complex, multi_phase:false, wire_subagent:null "first scan the repo and then run tests" → scope:complex, multi_phase:true, wire_subagent:null "use browser_use for weather" → scope:simple, multi_phase:false, wire_subagent:browser_use "add tests for the new API endpoint" → scope:simple, multi_phase:false, wire_subagent:null "migrate the auth system to OAuth2" → scope:complex, multi_phase:false, wire_subagent:null
